description: React component for managing and displaying agent execution data, including filtering, pagination, and detailed views.

methods.name: handleFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filter state based on user input.

methods.name: onDateChange
methods.description: Handles date selection and updates filter state with normalized date.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Fetches execution data based on current filters and pagination.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters to default values and refreshes data.

methods.name: handleDeleteDialogOpen
methods.description: Opens delete confirmation dialog if any executions are selected.

methods.name: handleDeleteExecutions
methods.description: Deletes selected executions and refreshes list.
